proposed_widenings.name: retarget_incoming_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The curse deterministically changes the target of a qualifying ranged-weapon attack to the shield bearer. No existing effect atom models attack retargeting or redirection.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

proposed_widenings.name: passive_triggered_combat_operation
proposed_widenings.justification: If the retargeting mechanic is added, passive magic items also need a non-spell trigger surface for always-on combat-event listeners. Current PassiveOperation only supports elapsed-time cadence.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you...

notes: The resistance half fits the existing passive magic-item surface via attack-scoped ranged-weapon resistance, but the cursed redirection rider cannot be encoded honestly without widening. No content/trace files were produced.
